Today, William went to the swimming pool. Between what times could they have gone?
We know that:
William woke up at 5am.
Jennifer saw William walking in the garden from 7am to 5pm.
Mary saw William reading at the library from 5pm to 6pm.
William saw William buying lunch at the deli from 6pm to 10pm.
The swimming pool was closed after 10pm.
Between what times could William have gone to the swimming pool?

Options:
(A) 5pm to 6pm
(B) 6pm to 10pm
(C) 5am to 7am
(D) 7am to 5pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)

- From 5am to 5pm, William was seen by Jennifer and Mary, so he cannot be seen between 5am and 5pm.
- From 5pm to 10pm, William was seen by Mary, so he cannot be seen between 5pm and 10pm.

The only time period left is from 7am to 6pm. During this time, William was not seen by anyone, so he could have gone to the swimming pool.

Answer: (B) 6pm to 10pm
